---
name: Bug Report
about: A skill is inaccurate, out of date, or misbehaves
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Which skill
e.g. `skills/floe`

## What's wrong
A clear description — e.g. an endpoint/schema/price that doesn't match the live product,
a broken link, or the skill routing when it shouldn't.

## Expected
What the skill should say or do.

## Evidence
Link to the source of truth (API response, docs, dashboard) that shows the correct value.

## Environment (if relevant)
- Client: Claude Code / Cursor / Agent SDK / other
- Skill version / release tag:
